producerCoverageFinding: build-inventory.mjs scans JSON + code/HTML/CSS with no SVG parser or approved-image asset traversal; zero SVG files/element records appear in frozen inventory. All 412 active Vietnamese desc producers are therefore omitted as asset consumers, even where their Vietnamese substring reuses covered manifest description/ALT copy.

identityPolicy.semanticIdentity: manifest illustration stable ID + XML element XPath; equal text is not merged
identityPolicy.occurrenceIdentity: asset file + exact local-name XPath / JSON file + pointer
identityPolicy.sourceIdentity: every SVG and loaded manifest frozen by SHA256; manifest declared asset SHA verified
identityPolicy.routeMultiplication: No unvisited route, zoom opening, or repeated image render is counted as a new semantic source unit.

renderingEvidence.approvedCourseImage: lesson-view.ts illustration(): file + publicationStatus=approved loads external SVG , uses alt.zh + alt.vi; zoom image reuses ALT; zoom paragraph uses description; figcaption uses label or bilingual fallback.
renderingEvidence.approvedCourseReachability: Current lesson illustrationManifest + explicit source owner / activity / field bindings, and currentAuxiliaryIllustrations package allowlist with expected 438 SHA-checked assets. This is configured active reachability, not pixel/native-browser certification.
renderingEvidence.historicalHSK1: figures.ts statically imports 10 old schematic SVGs, but resolveSourceFigure reads getSourceLesson; current catalogue uses lesson-04-current and all150 current original PNG crops. Old lesson-04 sourceLesson export is historical. No VI text/title/desc was detected in those10 SVGs.
renderingEvidence.svgAccessibilityLimit: Embedded SVG title/desc consumers are kept distinct from outer HTML img ALT. Their exact exposure depends on embedding/direct navigation; no accessibility browser claim is granted here.
